name: csd-fixer
description: GNOME Shell extension: restores GNOME native rounded corners and drop shadows to non-CSD applications

scripts.gen-style: node tools/gen-style.mjs && node tools/gen-shader.mjs && node tools/gen-mutter.mjs
scripts.check-style: node tools/gen-style.mjs --check && node tools/gen-shader.mjs --check && node tools/gen-mutter.mjs --check && node tools/gen-locale.mjs --check
scripts.pack: npm run compile-locales && mkdir -p dist && gnome-extensions pack src --force --extra-source=lib --extra-source=effects --extra-source=stylesheet.css --extra-source=locale --out-dir=dist
